rules.BANT_INCOMPLETE: BANT incomplete (budget, authority, need and timeline must be complete).
rules.ECONOMIC_BUYER_MISSING: No price request without an economic buyer: assign the role to a contact.
rules.DECISION_DATE_MISSING: No price request without a decision date.
rules.PRICE_REQUEST_NOT_SUBMITTED: The price request (A1) has not been sent to China.
rules.APPROVAL_EXPIRED: Approval expired on {{expiresOn}}: a new version and approval are required.
rules.BUSINESS_CASE_REQUIRED: Approved business case required (amount > USD 2M or margin < 60 %).
rules.MILESTONES_MISSING: The sheet has no cash-flow and T&C milestones.
rules.CASHFLOW_TC_MISMATCH: Cash-flow milestones ({{cashflow}}) do not match the T&C ({{tc}}).
rules.OFFER_VALIDITY_EXCEEDS_APPROVAL: Offer validity ({{offerValidUntil}}) exceeds approval expiry ({{approvalExpiresOn}}): adjust validity or renew the approval.
rules.SIGNED_CONTRACT_MISSING: Signed contract or PO missing in the repository with the standard name.
rules.HANDOFF_MISSING: Hand-off with local delivery and China R&D missing.
rules.ZMP_ID_MISSING: ZMP project or PO number missing.
rules.STAGE_DERIVED: Stages 9 to 11 are derived from milestones and cannot be set manually.
rules.OPPORTUNITY_NOT_WON: The opportunity is not won yet.
rules.SAME_STAGE: The opportunity is already in that stage.
rules.BACKWARD_REASON_REQUIRED: Give a reason to move the stage back.
rules.ENGINE_REQUIRED: The billing engine is mandatory from creation.
rules.STATUS_INVALID: Status not valid for this action ({{status}}).
rules.LINE_ITEMS_REQUIRED: The version has no line items.
rules.JUSTIFICATION_REQUIRED: Alex Xiao band: competitive justification is mandatory.
rules.TCO_HORIZON_REQUIRED: TCO must have a 3 to 5 year horizon.
rules.TARGET_PRICE_REQUIRED: Target price and reference competitor missing.
rules.MILESTONES_NOT_100: Payment milestones add up to {{total}} %; they must add to 100 %.
rules.SIMPLE_ESIGN_NOT_ACCEPTED: The account does not accept simple e-signatures: upload a handwritten scan or advanced signature.
rules.MILESTONE_NOT_ACCEPTED: The milestone must be accepted before sending it to Finance.
rules.MILESTONE_NOT_SENT_TO_FINANCE: The milestone has not been sent to China Finance.
rules.CONTACT_NOT_IN_ACCOUNT: The contact does not belong to the account.
rules.COMMENT_REQUIRED: A comment is mandatory when rejecting or requesting changes.
rules.PRICE_REQUEST_NOT_DRAFT: The request was already sent; the A1 sheet cannot be edited.
rules.SHEET_NOT_CURRENT: Only the current sheet version can be approved.
rules.APPROVAL_ALREADY_PENDING: There is already a pending approval for this opportunity.
rules.APPROVAL_NOT_PENDING: The approval is no longer pending.
rules.OPPORTUNITY_NOT_IN_ACCOUNT: The opportunity does not belong to the account.
rules.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: New work suspended for this account: no new POs or CRs.
rules.REPOSITORY_LINK_REQUIRED: An active contract must have a repository link.
rules.CONTRACT_AMOUNT_REQUIRED: The contract needs an opportunity and an amount.
rules.CONTRACT_WITHOUT_OPPORTUNITY: The contract is not linked to an opportunity.
rules.BILLING_LINE_ALREADY_INVOICED: This billing line already has an invoice.
rules.PAYMENT_CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The payment must be in the invoice currency ({{invoiceCurrency}}).
rules.COLLECTION_NOT_DUE: This collection action is not due yet (scheduled {{scheduledOn}}).
rules.CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_SELF: You cannot deactivate your own user.
rules.COMPLIANCE_NOT_REVIEWED: The checklist must be reviewed by Legal before approval (current status: {{status}}).
rules.CONTRACT_NOT_PO: The contract must be a PO.
rules.CR_EXCEPTION_EXPIRED: The Country Manager exception has expired ({{expiresOn}}).
rules.CR_LINES_REQUIRED: The CR needs at least one profile × hours line.
rules.DATE_RANGE_INVALID: End date must be after start date.
rules.DISTRIBUTOR_AGREEMENT_MISSING: The distributor has no active agreement.
rules.DISTRIBUTOR_OUT_OF_TERRITORY: The distributor agreement does not cover territory {{country}}.
rules.PO_REQUIRED: Work cannot start without a client PO or a Country Manager exception.
rules.RACI_ADMIN_LOCKOUT: The change would leave the Administrator role without ADM access.
rules.RATE_CARD_CURRENCY_MIX: CR rates are in different currencies ({{profile}}).
rules.SNAPSHOT_EXISTS: The snapshot for week {{week}} already exists.
rules.CATEGORY_INCONSISTENT: Commit is only allowed from the proposal stage onwards.
rules.RFP_REQUIREMENTS_PENDING: {{count}} requirements in the matrix are unanswered.
rules.RFP_CM_REVIEW_REQUIRED: The final answer needs the Country Manager review.
rules.RFP_ALREADY_DELIVERED: The RFP has already been delivered.
rules.RFP_NOT_DELIVERED: Record the delivery before the award.
rules.DELEGATION_ROLE_NOT_HELD: The holder does not have the role {{role}}.
rules.DELEGATE_NOT_FOUND: The delegate does not exist or is inactive.
rules.EDO_ID_MISSING: Row without an eDo id (issueId); it cannot be imported.
rules.EDO_CREATED_MISSING: Ticket {{number}} has no valid creation date.
rules.EDO_STATUS_ASSUMED: Ticket {{number}}: status "{{status}}" not recognized; imported as {{as}}.
rules.EDO_PRIORITY_ASSUMED: Ticket {{number}}: priority "{{priority}}" not recognized; imported as {{as}}.
rules.MAIL_CACHE_OLDER: The cache ({{received}}) is older than the last one imported ({{latest}}).
rules.CLIENT_NOT_MAPPED: Client "{{ref}}" matches no CRM account ({{projects}} topics, {{emails}} e-mails, {{meetings}} meetings). Not imported.
rules.CLIENT_AMBIGUOUS: Client "{{ref}}" matches more than one account; provide an alias.
